sources.note: Nothing on stress, accent, tone or prosody (0 hits for stress|accent|penult|tone|prosod on pp. 80-82). These include some unexpected changes, e.g. both *mw and *m merging to /n/ in Jo. Notable is also the incontiguous geographic distribution of some sound changes, e.g. the reflexes of *d and the labiovelarized sounds', plus linkage/cognacy/multilingualism discussion; approx. 500 vocabulary items per doculect in 'broad IPA'.
